note: Export side is factually confirmed but thin: exactly ONE customs shipment row seen (counter says 1, rows seen 1), dated 2024-11-23, Delhi Air Cargo -> New York, HS 61159990, B/L 5845446. The consignee is the company's own Amazon FBA warehouse in Port Saint Lucie, FL, so this is a single e-commerce/FBA replenishment consignment rather than a repeat B2B export flow; no second shipment, no other destination, no other HS code observed. Declared HS 611595 vs actual 61159990 — same 6-digit heading 6115 (knitted socks/footwear hosery), so no HS correction needed at 6-digit level; the 8-digit Indian tariff line is 61159990. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is inconsistent with the observed product (socks/apparel) — flag for the record, not a rejection ground. Domestic supply evidence: NOT FOUND — no GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP tender, no contract and no annual-report split could be retrieved; web_search backend was unavailable (connection refused) and thecompanycheck/zaubacorp returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is 'unknown', not 'none_found' — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic sales.
